content_sections.heading: ICAR IVRI Project Technical Support - III Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR IVRI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. content_sections.text: Project Technical Support - III: Three Year Graduate degree in Lifesciences + Three Year post qualification research experience OR Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology

content_sections.heading: Age Limit

content_sections.text: Project Technical Support - III: 28000 + 20% HRA per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IVRI Project Technical Support - III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for ICAR - Indian Veterinary Research Institute (ICAR IVRI), a government organization.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Technical Support – III.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Technical Support – III post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Project Technical Support – III is scheduled for 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for Project Technical Support – III is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Project Technical Support – III?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Technical Support – III is Rs. 28000 + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Three Year Graduate degree in Lifesciences + Three Year post qualification research experience OR a Post Graduate degree in Life Sciences / Biotechnology / Microbiology.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment includes a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
